**2026-08-12 SAEA-BENCH-featcache FORENSICS CLOSED — the collision was one off-by-one (no model touch; log + source forensics only).** Round-3's structure, read from the cold log: each 60 s slice is EIGHT ~104-token media chunks; per request exactly 5 encodes + 3 false hits at the even ordinals. Root cause, verified against source: `find_next_media_chunk` is `upper_bound` (STRICTLY greater), and the ordinal scan advanced by `start + n_tokens` — landing exactly ON the next chunk's start and skipping it, so even ordinals collapsed onto the preceding odd ones and o2/o4/o6 were injected with o1/o3/o5's features (~26 s of each slice heard the wrong audio → WER 0.57). Round-1's ~7.4 false hits/slice (bitmap-only keys, 8 chunks one key) closes under the same model. **Fix build `5d9dfcb58`** (receipt updated in this commit): the one-line advance fix plus a VALIDATE mode (`LLAMA_MTMD_FEAT_CACHE_VALIDATE=1`, fragment q4km-featcache-validate): the hit short-circuit is disabled, everything encodes, and every re-encountered key is byte-compared against the cache — a mismatch logs loudly and is overwritten with encoder truth. **Endgame trio pre-registered under this row:** VALIDATE-1 (populate + intra-run self-check), VALIDATE-2 (full-coverage compare; **806/806 MATCH and 0 MISMATCH is the constructive proof that the cache serves correct features — the owner's "WER alignment" question answered by construction**), then a clean warm (validation off, full hits) whose wall against the cold reference is **the measured efficiency gain under correct supply — the owner's question 2**. WER of every run is additionally judged against the fixedwindow reference 0.2316/0.2310.
